exposure: 15 inflammatory cytokines and growth factors in maternal plasma and serum (including TNFa and sICAM-1) collected at 17-23 weeks (T1) and 28-32 weeks (T2) gestation
outcome: Preterm birth (spontaneous preterm labour (sPTL), preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), and medically indicated preterm birth (mPTB))
cohort: Pregnant women whose maternal cytokine and growth factor levels were measured during the second and third trimesters.
finding: The change in TNFa levels over time (T2/T1) significantly classified medically indicated preterm birth (mPTB) from term birth with an AUC of 0.79, although the overall clinical utility for prediction was considered low.
gest_age: Births included preterm (<37 weeks) and term (>=37 weeks); measurements were taken at 17-23 weeks and 28-32 weeks gestation.
